career_ladder.note: Career progression for Police Sub-Inspectors (Daroga) under the Home (Police) Department, Government of Bihar. Direct recruit Sub-Inspectors form the operational core of police stations and supervisory investigation units, advancing to Inspector, Deputy Superintendent of Police (BPS cadre), and eventual induction into the Indian Police Service (IPS).

exam_scheme.note: Selection process conducted by BPSSC comprises three stages: (1) Preliminary Written Examination (100 MCQs, 200 marks, GK & Current Affairs, 0.2 negative marking) shortlisting candidates in a 1:20 ratio; (2) Main Written Examination comprising Paper 1 Hindi (qualifying, 30%) and Paper 2 General Studies (200 marks, determining merit for PET in 1:6 ratio); and (3) Physical Efficiency & Standard Test (PET/PST, qualifying only). Final merit rank is prepared strictly on marks obtained in Mains Paper 2.

stages.source_label: BPSSC Police Sub-Inspector Advt. No. 05/2025 Preliminary Exam Result & Scheme

papers.paper_name: General Knowledge & Current Affairs (सामान्य ज्ञान एवं समसामयिक मुद्दे)
papers.negative_marking: 0.2 marks deducted per wrong answer (2 marks per correct answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 30% marks; candidates shortlisted in 1:20 ratio of vacancies (equipercentile normalization applied for multi-shift exams)

stages.source_label: BPSSC Police Sub-Inspector Advt. No. 05/2025 Exam Regulations

papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory 30% marks; marks not counted in final merit; Paper 2 evaluated only if candidate passes Paper 1

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: General Studies, Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Maths & Mental Ability
papers.negative_marking: 0.2 marks deducted per wrong answer (2 marks per correct answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Final merit rank is computed strictly on marks obtained in Paper 2; candidates shortlisted for PET in 1:6 ratio

stages.stage_name: Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standards (PST)
stages.source_label: BPSSC Police Sub-Inspector Physical Standards Regulations

papers.paper_name: Physical Efficiency Test: Running (1.6 km in 6.5 min male / 1 km in 6 min female), High Jump (4 ft male / 3 ft female), Long Jump (12 ft male / 9 ft female), Shot Put (16 lb min 16 ft male / 12 lb min 10 ft female)
papers.negative_marking: Strictly qualifying; failure in any single event leads to disqualification
papers.qualifying_threshold: PST: Height 165 cm (UR/BC), 160 cm (EBC/SC/ST), 155 cm (Female); Chest 81-86 cm

financial_package.note: Police Sub-Inspectors are appointed in Pay Matrix Level 6 (Basic ₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400). In addition to standard state pay and DA, personnel receive special police duty allowance, ration money, investigation grant, and uniform allowance.
financial_package.pay_source_label: BPSSC Police Sub-Inspector Advt. No. 05/2025 Preliminary Exam Result & Cadre Details
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹35,400 with 58% DA (₹20,532), HRA (8% to 16% depending on posting: ₹2,832 to ₹5,664), monthly Ration Money Allowance (₹3,000), Medical Allowance (₹1,000), Special Police Duty Allowance, and Transport Allowance. In-hand reflects 10% NPS deduction on Basic+DA (₹5,593), professional tax, and police welfare deductions.
official_perks: Government earmarked official residential quarters or HRA up to 16%
Monthly Ration Money Allowance and special investigation expense imprest
Annual uniform allowance and official kit equipment

Official mobile phone allowance and CUG SIM facility
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% state contribution
